entities.name: Jarosław Lindenberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jarosław Lindenberg is a Polish diplomat and philosopher. Between 11 September 2023 and 13 December 2023, he served as the Under Undersecretary of State at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. He was previously the Polish ambassador to Latvia (1992–1997), Bulgaria (1998–2003), and Bosnia and Herzegovina (2018-2023), as well as chargé d'affaires to Montenegro (2007–2011).
